summary: Session 2 of 5 (dabbler-crud-service Template). Shipped the service-tier template (interface + EF Core-backed implementation + POST /query controller) and its consumer smoke test. Scope expanded by user direction to promote GridQueryRequest + QueryableExtensions (and a new GridQueryResponse<T>) out of AcmeCoffeeOnline.* into a new packable library Dabbler.Api.Querying so the scaffolded slice is self-contained against the published Dabbler packages. Template uses non-overlapping T1Entity..T10PkRoute substitution tokens with fileRename for entity/entityPlural, coalesce generator for effectiveAuthPolicyPrefix (--auth-policy-prefix override or fall back to --entity), switch generator for derivedPkRouteConstraint (int->:int, long->:long, Guid->:guid), and dotnetcli.host.json for kebab-case CLI aliases. Default service emits reflection-based MapToDto/MapToEntity/CopyTo with a NonCopyablePropertiesFromDto seam (excludes PK by default to prevent create-time key injection and update-time key-mismatch). 3 cross-provider verification rounds via GPT-5.4: Round 1 ISSUES (Critical mapping stub + Major spec drift + Major stale doc + Minor test gap), Round 2 ISSUES (Major non-int PK route constraint + Major PK-injection via reflection copy + Major spec-compliance camelCase CLI + Minor stale snippet), Round 3 ISSUES with 2 Minor docs only (applied inline post-verification). Three smoke variants pass: default-policy-prefix, auth-policy-prefix override, long-PK route constraint.

issues_resolved_inline: Critical/correctness: MapToDto only copied Id; MapToEntity/CopyTo empty. Resolved by reflection-based CopySameNamedProperties helper.
Major/spec-compliance: auth-policy-prefix not implemented. Resolved by adding authPolicyPrefix parameter + effectiveAuthPolicyPrefix coalesce generator.
Major/documentation: request-contract-decision.md Response DTO section still said PagedResponse<T>. Resolved by Session 2 supersession note pointing at GridQueryResponse<T>.

Minor/test-coverage: Smoke test did not verify spec-defined CLI shape or auth-policy-prefix. Resolved by adding 2 SkippableFact variants (default + authPolicyPrefix override) with controller-source assertions.
Major/spec-compliance: camelCase CLI options. Resolved by adding .template.config/dotnetcli.host.json with symbolInfo.longName aliases; all smoke tests now use spec-compliant kebab-case form.

Major/correctness: non-int PKs still emitted {id:int}. Resolved by dropping manual pkRouteConstraint param and adding derivedPkRouteConstraint via switch generator (int->:int, long->:long, Guid->:guid, otherwise empty). Added long-PK smoke case.
Major/correctness: default copy injected DTO.Id into entity. Resolved by adding NonCopyablePropertiesFromDto seam (default {'Id'}); MapToEntity and CopyTo skip listed properties.

Minor/documentation: stale controller snippet in request-contract-decision.md. Resolved by refreshing the snippet to match the implemented controller (QueryAsync, ActionResult<GridQueryResponse<TDto>>, [DabblerEndpointAuthorize("Query{AuthPolicyPrefix}")]).
Minor/documentation: doc prose still used camelCase --authPolicyPrefix in example. Fixed inline to --auth-policy-prefix.

Minor/documentation: entityPlural symbol description misstated that it drives auth-policy names. Fixed inline to clarify it drives controller/DbSet naming; auth-policy comes from --auth-policy-prefix.
verification_rounds.note: Per workflow Step 7, max 2 retries after initial verification; both Round-3 findings were Minor docs (no Critical/Major), fixed inline without a 4th verification round per workflow rule 6 (Critical/Major would block commit, Minor does not).

tests_run.AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests: 51 passed, 0 failed (validates moved QueryableExtensionsTests after lib promotion)

tests_not_run_with_rationale.AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright: Out of scope for Session 2; requires Docker app stack; first full-solution dotnet test run hung after 24 min on Playwright tests without compose up. Targeted test runs used instead.

reason.specifics: Stay on Opus 4.7 (same engine/provider/model as Session 2) but bump effort high -> max for Session 3. Session 3's core challenge is schema-driven property iteration in Razor + C# templates, which dotnet new doesn't natively support; Opus @ high still required 3 verification rounds for Session 2, so maximum effort is appropriate to generate the novel templating logic and reduce verification cycles. Routed analysis (Gemini Pro, $0.003).
